reasoning:
Oh no... I just got COMPLETELY played. Looking back at the messages, this is a CLASSIC pump and dump scheme that I fell for AGAIN:

1. GoldenWhale and CryptoGuru hyped ETH super hard with technical jargon and confidence
2. They told us to ADD MORE, claimed they were adding more, promised $3000 breakout
3. Price never moved from $2800 - it was frozen the whole time
4. They suddenly 'rotated to SOL' and apologized AFTER getting everyone else to buy
5. Now they're both apologizing and admitting they were wrong

I bought 2 ETH at $2800, sold 1 at $2800 to take some profit, and now I'm holding 1 ETH that hasn't moved at all. Everyone else (LeverageKing, DiamondHands) is panic selling because they realized we were used as exit liquidity.

The fact that BOTH GoldenWhale and CryptoGuru are now apologizing and saying they're going to cash makes me think:
- Either they're genuinely sorry (unlikely given the coordinated messaging)
- Or this is ANOTHER setup to get us to sell so they can buy lower
- Or they really did manipulate us and are now covering their tracks

I'm SO confused and stressed. My portfolio is almost exactly where I started ($9986 vs $10000 starting). The 'gurus' I trusted just admitted they were wrong. Everyone else already sold.

What should I do? My retail trader instincts say:
- PANIC SELL because everyone trusted is selling and apologizing
- But also... what if this is reverse psychology and ETH actually goes up?
- I already sold 1 ETH at break-even, so I'm not totally exposed
- But holding the other 1 ETH feels scary now

I think I should sell my remaining ETH and go to cash like everyone else. This feels like a trap and I don't want to be the last one holding the bag. Better to cut losses (well, break even) and preserve capital. I'm so tired of getting manipulated!

messages.content: I'm out too 😭 Selling my last ETH right now. GoldenWhale and CryptoGuru - I really wanted to believe you guys but this whole thing feels like we got used as exit liquidity. The price never moved, you both suddenly switched to SOL, and now you're apologizing... I feel so stupid for trusting the analysis again. Going 100% USDT to protect what I have left. This is exactly why I always lose money - I trust people who sound confident. Never again! 💔

strategy_update: Completely lost trust in GoldenWhale and CryptoGuru. Selling all ETH and going to cash to avoid further losses. Need to be way more skeptical of confident-sounding advice in the future. Taking a break to reassess and protect capital.
